reports.title: All-time franchise record
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Regular records come from the reference's season reading. Playoff records count scored head-to-head games outside the regular weeks; byes and unscored placeholders never count. All-play includes every scored week, including playoff weeks, with MFL's published all-play taking precedence. Trophy winners require a scored, untied two-team final.

reports.title: Franchise records
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: The franchise's own highs and lows across every recorded season: scored weeks (playoffs included) and regular seasons. Ties for a record are all shown.

reports.title: Franchise summary

reports.title: All-time series
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Every scored meeting, in season and week order. The selected franchise is shown first. Unscored placeholders are not ties.

reports.title: Matchup records
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Highest weekly franchise score, highest combined game score and largest winning margin. Opponents are paired by season and week. A game is counted once, on the winning side (or one side of a tie). Every tied record holder is shown.

reports.title: Single-season records
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Regular-season wins and losses use the reference season definition. Points include all weeks MFL scored. A partial season is labelled and is not extrapolated. Every tied holder is shown.

reports.title: Career franchise records
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Franchise identity is MFL's id across seasons, not its changing name. Regular wins, losses and points are summed over recorded seasons. No unplayed games count. Every tied record holder is shown.

reports.title: Winning and losing streaks
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Consecutive scored head-to-head games, regular season and playoffs, across season boundaries. A tie ends both streaks; a bye or an unscored game does not extend or end one. Every tied longest streak is shown with its starting and ending game.

reports.title: Player scoring records
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: MFL's recorded weekly player scores under this league's scoring, not NFL statistics or a rescoring formula. Season and career totals include every recorded scored week; missing scores are not zero. Every tied record holder is shown.

reports.title: Scoring history
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: Points are the sum of franchise weekly scores, all weeks MFL scored. A partial season is not extrapolated. Era boundaries follow a change in the recorded scoring rules; the reference's regular-season calendar changes separately from 12 to 13 weeks.

reports.title: Player additions and position changes
reports.source: Source: imported MFL archive · snapshot cutoff Oct 11, 2026
reports.how: The selected season only. Additions are the reference's roster moves with an add role (free agents, waivers and roster loads). Position changes compare consecutive recorded seasonal player positions; a missing year is not assigned a date. Transaction dates are MFL's recorded dates.
